visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Walk a Pointer Instead of an Index
visualizerParams.problemDescription: An index variable is used to read each element. Rewrite the loop so a pointer walks from the first element up to the end. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Pointer iteration is the idiom behind many C library functions: start at the first element, stop at the address just past the last one. The hard-coded count 5 is replaced by a value computed from the array itself.
